blocks.x: Applying Agentic AI & Hyperautomation to Care Management & Population Health: the context that decides the design, the weekly cadence, the towers involved, and committed outcomes per gate.

Care management succeeds on precision targeting and timely intervention: identifying rising-risk members, coordinating across providers, and proving quality outcomes. It is a data-discipline business — and the data discipline is usually the missing part.

items: Care outreach, scheduling and follow-up run on call lists; gaps between contacts lose members.
Claims, clinical, SDOH and engagement data siloed; risk stratification runs on claims only.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Process & Task Mining, Process & Task Mining, Autonomous Workflow Orchestration from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Risk stratification, Care outreach and scheduling, Program matching) on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — HIPAA among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: See the work as it actually runs: event-log truth before you automate anything.
One automation spine: APIs, events, RPA and agents composable under common control.
Workflows that recover from failure on their own — long-running business processes that adapt, retry and recover without tickets.
Contact plans executed across channels with follow-up policy (completion up 25-40%)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Healthcare & Life Sciences level this capability reads as: payer denial letters parsed, evidence assembled, appeal packets drafted (overturn rate up 20-30%). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Every program of this type runs the same weekly rhythm, so your team can plan around it. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
